Class Game.CustomEvent

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core.GameDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an event that triggers at a specified interval, allowing actions to be executed at regular time steps or every frame.

public abstract class Game.CustomEvent : IComparable<Game.CustomEvent>

Remarks

ScheduledGameEvents are sorted first by their Order property, then by a unique internal id. If two ScheduledGameEvents have the same order, the one created earlier (with a lower id) is processed first.

The execution order for this event. Lower values are executed first.

Fields

Order

Determines the execution order of the CustomEvent. Lower values are executed before higher values.

public readonly int Order

Field Value

int

Methods

CompareTo(CustomEvent?)

Compares this Game.CustomEvent to another for sorting in a SortedSet<T>. Events are first compared by Order, then by unique id to ensure consistent ordering.

public int CompareTo(Game.CustomEvent? other)

Parameters

other Game.CustomEvent

The other Game.CustomEvent to compare with.

Returns

int

Less than zero if this instance precedes other in the sort order, zero if they are equal, or greater than zero if it follows other.

Remarks

Each CustomEvent instance receives a unique id, ensuring that no two different ScheduledGameEvents are ever considered equal. As a result, this method only returns 0 when comparing an instance to itself.

Remarks

Only called when Game.FixedPhysicsEnabled is set to true! Fixed Physics call order:

  • PreUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo)
  • PostUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo)
  • PreFixedUpdate(GameTime, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo)

  • PreInterpolateFixedUpdate(GameTime, float, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo, ScreenInfo)
